title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 393A (Exemptions under this Chapter)

content.overview: The Central Government may, by notification, exempt any class of foreign companies, or companies incorporated or to be incorporated outside India (whether or not they have or may establish a place of business in India), from any of the provisions of Chapter XXII, subject to such conditions as may be specified in the notification.
content.glance: CG may notify exemptions from Chapter XXII for classes of foreign / outside-India companies.
content.study: Section 393A is an exemption power. Application of Chapter XXII may depend on the Act text and any valid exemption notification for the relevant class.

sections.heading: Exemption power
sections.body: CG may exempt classes of foreign / outside-India companies from Chapter XXII provisions.

sections.heading: Conditions
sections.body: Exemption may be subject to conditions in the notification.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.body: Always check for current exemption notifications before applying Chapter XXII.

examples.title: Application of Section 393
examples.body: Facts satisfying the elements in the statutory text of Section 393 produce the consequence described in that section.

hypotheticals.question: Do the facts engage Section 393?
hypotheticals.analysis: Compare facts with the statutory elements in Section 393.

distinctions.title: Scope of Section 393
distinctions.body: Section 393 applies only within its statutory text.

misconceptions.correction: It operates only as stated in the statutory text.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should section 393A be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the class of company. II. Check for a valid exemption notification. III. Apply remaining Chapter XXII duties. IV. Conclude.

examTips: Exemption is by CG notification; always check currency.
